## Result

- Skill: proposal-review
- Review status: approved
- Vision alignment: aligned
- Material findings: none
- Open blockers: none for this direction assessment.
- Proposal readiness: unchanged approved direction remains applicable to current contextual sources.
- Immediate next stage: isolated stop; responsible downstream assessors retain their separate authority.
- Automatic downstream handoff: none.
- Claim limitations: continued proposal-direction reliance only. No Design, milestone, source-deletion, final-adoption, Verify, publication or PR approval is established here.

## Review Dimensions

- Challenge: pass. Fragmented Release authority and the missing requirement for one complete routine operator path remain the unchanged, concrete problems.
- Goals: pass. One normal approval, automatic preparation/checks/publication/observation/reporting, the Release model and justified source retirement remain explicit outcomes.
- Scope: pass. Routine candidate-bound operation, timing-policy amendment and necessary consumer reconciliation stay bounded. Other model transfers and actual publication retain separate authority. The current source/realization edits introduce no additional proposal-level responsibility.
- Governing principle: pass. The system performs and verifies the exact authorized operation and exposes real exceptions.
- Direction: pass. Exact source/artifact/destination binding, material-change reapproval, safe duplicate/uncertain-outcome handling, explicit prerequisites and preserved public evidence remain selected. Current contextual changes do not contradict them.
- Feasibility: pass. Existing profile/preparation/preflight/full-verification/public-closeout mechanisms remain present. Current workflow now names preparation and protected execution through the selected coordinator. This is adequate continuing feasibility context; this review does not establish those implementations correct or sufficient.
- Material impact: pass. The amended proposal still discloses actual automation/timing changes, irreversible external consequences and separate authority. No new material direction trade-off follows from the bounded navigation/factual updates.
- Vision alignment: pass, aligned. Durable inspectable decisions, authority and observed results preserve the engineering evidence chain; reducing duplicated routine manual entry does not replace human approval or independent judgments.
- Downstream authority: pass. Design owns precise contracts, Delivery allocation and implementation reviewers retain their own decisions, and final whole-change Code Review plus distinct Verify remain required. Renewing this proposal does not approve their work.
- Requested decision: pass. The same direction approval for one-approval routine operation, nonblocking duration telemetry and coherent source consolidation remains explicit and bounded.

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass. User goals remain unchanged: one normal approval; automated required work and evidence; exact candidate-bound authority and safe retries; unavailable timings nonblocking; no duplicate manual entry; Release model, six-source inspection group and justified cleanup; preserved release safety. No missing original goal or hidden additional model was found.
- System's updated Release owner row defines successful final Verify in the owning change as the basis establishing coordinated adoption and points to exact source dispositions. Read with its unchanged adoption contract, it does not declare that Verify has already succeeded or that M1–M3 approval completes the entire initiative.
- Release's Building Block and consumer rows now name the selected immutable-candidate/provider/coordination helpers, protected environment executor and separately recorded observations instead of the earlier tag-triggered publisher. This is factual technical context for the already-selected direction, not a new proposal decision. Its technical accuracy and completeness belong to independent Design/Code Review.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: retain approved proposal-direction reliance with this new exact-basis record. Keep original r4 unchanged/stale. Source cleanup and final adoption remain pending their own required implementation and assessments.
- Assessment scope: complete unchanged proposal and current necessary direction context. R4's proposal identity is unchanged. Among its contextual identities, System, release-verify.sh, release.yml and release_transaction.py changed. The System amendment was inspected in full diff; the Release realization/consumer-row diff was inspected for direction impact. Current workflow preparation/protected-execution declarations and existing helper/check entrypoints were inspected only to establish that the proposal's feasible-mechanism premise remains supported. No complete runtime conformance or current hosted configuration claim follows.
- Evidence limitations: the same original nonauthor proposal assessor performed this renewal. Earlier r3/r4 substantive assessment informs it, but old subjects are not retargeted. Unchanged Constitution, Vision, retention/source contracts, ADRs and follow-up ownership remain the direction basis. This assessment does not rely on a future clean Design judgment, treat milestone approval as final adoption, or dispose another reviewer's findings.
- Actual checks: bounded Git diffs and source reads; exact identity comparison; primary CLI context and full subject inspect; targeted batch recording. No release, publication, package/runtime execution or historical benchmark was performed. Scoped record-store validation and diff hygiene run after saving and establish structure only.

## Specialized-gate group

- Active gate predicates: scope_budget_context=true; vision_exception_context=false; standing_artifact_context=false.
- Gate outcomes: scope-budget pass. Routine execution, coordination, telemetry and cleanup remain explicitly classified; other models and external publication stay separately authorized.
- Trigger ambiguity: none.

## Durable-recording group

- Recording status: recorded through targeted batch on successful save.
- Recording blocker: none.
- Record path: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r5.json
- Finding-record paths: none.

## Formal-review group

- Review ID: proposal-review-r5
- Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r5.json
- Governed change identity: 2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation
- Invocation classification: formal-lifecycle/manual; PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
- Independence: original independent proposal reviewer did not author or edit the proposal, contextual changes or implementation. Writes only this direction judgment/applicability, not engineering or activity/work routing.
independence_basis: Original independent proposal assessor did not author the proposal, contextual Design changes or implementation; assessed unchanged direction and bounded current feasibility context without granting technical approval.
